## ACTINOMYCES SPP.
Optimal therapy depends on both the disease or syndrome and the pathogen. See
diagnosis/syndrome section for more information.
## Preferred treatment
[Penicillin G 4 million units IV q4h [R]](psjizid-penicillin-g-4-million-units-iv-q4h)
< OR >
[Ampicillin 2 gm IV q4h [R]](psjizid-ampicillin-2-gm-iv-q4h)
< OR >
[Amoxicillin 500 mg PO q8h [R]](psjzid-amoxicillin-500mg-po-q8h)
## Alternative for severe beta-lactam allergy
[Assessment of Beta-lactam Reaction](orz-gtx-abx-beta-lactam-reaction-pdf)
[Doxycycline 100 mg IV q12h [DI]](psjizid-doxycycline-100mg-iv-q12h)
< OR >
[Doxycycline 100 mg PO q12h [DI]](psjzid-doxycycline-100mg-po-q12h)
